facts.fact: The state news agency reports that loi n°15/2014 of 7 January 2015 instituting and organising the national statistical system, as modified by loi n°016/2022 of 6 September 2022, is the legislation currently in force.
facts.system: Loi n°15/2014 du 7 janvier 2015 instituant et organisant le Système statistique national (2015)

facts.fact: The Minister of Planning and Prospective presented to the Council of Ministers on 22 May 2026 a bill amending ten articles of the statistics law (articles 2, 8, 9, 10, 12, 17, 22, 26, 27 and 35) to conform it to the Constitution of 19 December 2024; it was a bill before cabinet, not enacted.
facts.system: Projet de loi portant modification de certaines dispositions de la loi n°15/2014 instituant et organisant le Système statistique national (2026)

systems.owner: Ministère de la Planification et de la Prospective

facts.fact: The decree of August 2024 cites loi n°015/2014 of 7 January 2015 instituting and organising the National Statistical System, as amended by loi n°016/2022 of 6 September 2022, as the legal basis it is taken under.
facts.system: Loi n°015/2014 portant institution et organisation du Système Statistique National (2015, amended 2022)

facts.fact: Décret n°0314/PR/MPP of 1 August 2024 (signed 2 August, published in Journal Officiel n°31 of 15 August 2024) approves the statutes of the Institut National de la Statistique, citing the statistics law among its legal bases.
facts.system: Loi n°015/2014 portant institution et organisation du Système Statistique National (2015, amended 2022)

facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy page says the Head of State promulgated loi n°015/2014 instituting and organising the National Statistical System, while noting that the 1983 ministry-organisation decree still defines the statistics directorate's missions; the page gives no promulgation date, so the year comes from the law's number.
facts.system: Loi n°015/2014 portant institution et organisation du Système Statistique National

systems.system: Direction Générale de la Statistique (Institut National de la Statistique)
